desc_lfm_artist:
Bats is the name of more than one artist.

1) Progressive / Post punk / Math Rock band from Ireland.
2) Bedroom pop solo recording project of Jess Awh, based in Nashville, Tennessee. 
3) alias of Mike Martocci
4) South African garage rock band with Pete Clifford.
5) a variation on The Bats

1) Bats are a five piece rock band based in Dublin, Ireland. Formed in 2007, they play a blend of post-punk, hardcore and math rock, with lyrics drawing heavily from science subject areas.

title: This Is Not A Dream
desc_lfm_artist: Dadamah were a band from New Zealand, active during the early 1990s. The band consisted of Kim Pieters, Peter Stapleton, Roy Montgomery, and Janine Stagg. Montgomery and Stapleton had played previously played together in The Pin Group, who disbanded back in 1982. After the band broke up, the members went on to numerous other music projects, including Flies Inside The Sun, Doramaar, Dissolve, and Rain.

You might've heard the monotone voice in this meme before. The person narrating in it is none other than Dylan aka Chills. Dylan, better known as Chills or Top15s is a Canadian YouTuber in the YouTube horror narration community as well as a musician who released the Number 15 mixtape on October 15th, 2019.

title: Bird-Dog
desc_lfm_artist:
The Verlaines were a rock band from Dunedin, New Zealand notable for combining rock passion with classical compositional ideas. The Verlaines formed in 1981 and released their last studio album in 1997. In 2003 a career retrospective You're just too obscure for me was released.

The band were named after French poet Paul Verlaine - not, as is occasionally suggested, after Tom Verlaine (front man for the New York punk band Television).
